name: LKK Website Revamp
install: echo 'No build step required; static HTML is served over HTTP.'
start: cd /workspace && if ! curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8000/; then setsid python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 0.0.0.0 > /tmp/static-server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & fi

terminals.name: static-server
terminals.command: cd /workspace && if curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8000/; then echo 'static-server already running (launched by start hook); tailing log' && touch /tmp/static-server.log && exec tail -f /tmp/static-server.log; else exec python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 0.0.0.0; fi
terminals.description: Serves the static homepage files on port 8000. Chinese homepage: http://localhost:8000/ (index.html). English homepage: http://localhost:8000/index-en.html.
